places.name: Nairobi National Park
places.ai_summary: A unique wildlife park located near the city center, offering a chance to see lions, rhinos, and giraffes in their natural habitat.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended for game drives.

places.place_tip: Carry binoculars for better wildlife viewing.

places.name: Karen Blixen Museum
places.ai_summary: The former home of Karen Blixen, author of 'Out of Africa', now a museum showcasing her life and work.
places.place_tip: Explore the gardens and enjoy the serene environment.

places.name: Giraffe Centre
places.ai_summary: A conservation center for the endangered Rothschild giraffe, offering visitors a chance to feed and interact with these majestic animals.

opening_hours.notes: Best time to visit is in the morning.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture moments with the giraffes.

places.name: David Sheldrick Elephant Orphanage
places.ai_summary: A sanctuary for orphaned elephants, where visitors can learn about elephant conservation and even adopt an elephant.
places.place_tip: Consider adopting an elephant to support conservation efforts.

places.name: Bomas of Kenya Cultural Village
places.ai_summary: A cultural center showcasing traditional Kenyan music, dance, and crafts, offering a glimpse into the diverse cultures of Kenya.
places.place_tip: Don't miss the traditional dance performances.

places.name: Nairobi National Museum
places.ai_summary: The premier museum in Nairobi, showcasing Kenya's rich cultural and natural heritage, including art, archaeology, and paleontology.
places.place_tip: Visit the adjacent Nairobi Snake Park.

places.name: KICC Helipad City View
places.ai_summary: The helipad atop the Kenyatta International Conference Centre offers a panoramic view of Nairobi's skyline and surrounding areas.
places.place_tip: Arrive early to secure a good spot for photos.

places.name: Karura Forest Trails & Waterfall
places.ai_summary: An urban forest offering a network of walking and cycling trails, picnic sites, and a waterfall, providing a natural escape within the city.
places.place_tip: Watch out for monkeys and birds.

places.name: Nairobi Arboretum
places.ai_summary: A botanical garden and arboretum with a wide variety of indigenous and exotic trees, shrubs, and flowers, offering a peaceful retreat for nature lovers.
places.place_tip: Ideal for bird watching and photography.

places.name: Uhuru Gardens National Monument
places.ai_summary: A national monument and park commemorating Kenya's independence, featuring gardens, sculptures, and a museum.
places.place_tip: Learn about Kenya's struggle for independence.

places.name: Railway Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing the history of the railway in Kenya, with a collection of vintage locomotives, carriages, and other railway memorabilia.
places.place_tip: Check out the interactive exhibits.

places.name: Kazuri Beads Women’s Cooperative
places.ai_summary: A workshop and store where visitors can learn about and purchase handmade ceramic beads and pottery, supporting local women artisans.
places.place_tip: Purchase unique souvenirs and support a good cause.

places.name: Village Market & Two Rivers Mall
places.ai_summary: Popular shopping and entertainment destinations in Nairobi, offering a variety of shops, restaurants, and recreational activities.
places.place_tip: Enjoy a meal at one of the many restaurants.

places.name: Maasai Market (Souvenirs)
places.ai_summary: A vibrant open-air market where visitors can buy traditional Maasai crafts, jewelry, and souvenirs directly from the artisans.

opening_hours.notes: Bargaining is part of the shopping experience.

places.place_tip: Look for unique handmade items.

places.name: Ngong Hills Hike
places.ai_summary: A popular hiking destination offering stunning views of the Great Rift Valley and Nairobi skyline, with well-marked trails and picnic spots.
places.place_tip: Enjoy a picnic with a view.

places.name: Paradise Lost Caves & Falls
places.ai_summary: A scenic spot featuring limestone caves, a waterfall, and picnic sites, located just outside Nairobi.
places.place_tip: Explore the caves and enjoy the waterfall.

places.name: Kitengela Glass & Bridge
places.ai_summary: A unique attraction featuring a glass bridge and sculptures, located in the Kitengela area, known for its artistic glass creations.
places.place_tip: Watch out for glass art demonstrations.

places.name: City Market & Biashara Street
places.ai_summary: A bustling market area in Nairobi offering a wide range of goods, from fresh produce to crafts and souvenirs.

opening_hours.notes: Bargaining is common in the market.

places.place_tip: Try some local street food.

places.name: Uhuru Park & Central Business District Walk
places.ai_summary: A popular recreational park in Nairobi, ideal for picnics, walks, and relaxation, located near the Central Business District.
places.name_english: Uhuru Park & Central Business District Walk
places.place_tip: Enjoy a boat ride on the park's lake.

places.name: Carnivore Restaurant Experience
places.ai_summary: A famous restaurant in Nairobi known for its 'beast of a feast' - a variety of meats cooked on a skewer and served until you say 'stop'.
places.place_tip: Come hungry and ready to try various meats.
